Method of Attack: Decoy URL drops and installs Trillian messaging app, which then downloads and installs RuRAT remote access trojan
Remote access trojan used for malicious purposes to gain control over host, search for credentials and sensitive data, and spread laterally in network
Impacted Systems: Windows devices (implied by executable files and folder path C:\swrbldin)
Attack Vector: Spear-phishing email with fake venture capitalist offer
Malicious download from fake Vuxner chat website
User installs decoy software (Trillian) which triggers RAT installation
Indicators of Compromise: C:\swrbldin folder with batch files and VBS scripts
